items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think Joe Henderson was on that date.

ctx.x: Yeah, it’s The Prisoner. That’s right. It just lists you as flute, but that’s true.
Yeah. I played alto flute too. I think Joe Henderson was on that date.
Yes, he was. They’ve got him listed as alto flute. So they must have messed up.
